proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL CONCERNING SHAREHOLDERS' RIGHT TO ACT BY WRITTEN CONSENT
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders holding the minimum votes necessary to act to take action by written consent.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL CONCERNING INDEPENDENT BOARD CHAIRMAN
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to adopt a policy requiring the Chair of the Board to be an independent director, whenever possible.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL CONCERNING DISPOSAL OF UNUSED OR EXPIRED DRUGS
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to report on existing policies for safe disposal of prescription drugs to prevent water pollution and set out policy options, including industry take-back funding.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
